question: On identical patients and image patches, does replacing frozen Virchow2 with frozen UNI2-h change the loss of balanced accuracy caused by class imbalance, and does that change arise in the prior-only channel, the support-only channel, or their interaction?

encoders.candidate_lock_pending: checkpoint SHA-256, transform, and pooling frozen in phase 02 (encoder_lock.json), not here

tcga_ut.budget_formula: G x BALANCED x num_classes = 20 x 32 x 30 = 19200

bracs.budget_formula: G x BALANCED x num_classes = 10 x 32 x 7 = 2240

splits.source: existing patient-disjoint splits reused from exp-25/26, unchanged

draws.seed_source: prevalence.PREVALENCE_SEED (reused as-is; not a fresh seed, per protocol line 11: fresh draws do not create a fresh test cohort)

collision_audit.method: find <experiment>/outputs -type d -name draw_* on Hydra, unioned draw indices, for every 03_class_imbalance experiment (25-38)
collision_audit.result: draw indices 10-19 and 10000 unused everywhere; no collision, safe to freeze

row_weighting: prevalence.fit._prior_weights: w_c = (target_share_c) / (observed_share_c), rows sum to N
allocator: imbalance_benchmark.construction.allocate_counts (exp-02 exponential profile), reused unchanged; class rank permuted per draw via prevalence.fit.class_permutation
primary_contrast: delta_R = D_R(UNI2-h, rho=100) - D_R(Virchow2, rho=100), one endpoint per dataset, where D_X(m,rho) = A(m,B) - A(m,Xrho)
decomposition_identity: delta_R = delta_P + delta_S + delta_I (must hold numerically; I = D_R - D_P - D_S)

readout.model: existing multinomial logistic probe, native encoder outputs, no PCA/whitening/unit normalization

lambda_grid.boundary_expansion_rule: if the engineering pilot selects an endpoint, expand that boundary one decade for both encoders and datasets, repeat until interior or declare feasibility unresolved; freeze the resulting common grid before the main run

readout.b_selected_lambda_sensitivity: re-evaluate each encoder's arms at that encoder's B-selected lambda as a secondary sensitivity; never impose one encoder's lambda on the other as proof of equal regularization

calibration.method: one positive scalar temperature per selected arm, fit on validation patients, existing calibration objective
calibration.objective_frozen_in: phase 04 (objective, weighting, bounds, ECE bins traced from the existing implementation)
calibration.metrics: raw and scaled macro NLL and ECE

inference.resampling: paired training-draw resampling within split, identical weights across encoders/arms, independent of evaluation-patient-cluster resampling; patient multiplicity carried to every occurrence across arms/encoders/split test sets; class support preserved (BRACS multi-label patients not independently resampled per label)
inference.undefined_recall_rule: redraw the replicate and record the rejection count; never turn undefined recall into zero
inference.primary_ci: two-sided 97.5% percentile intervals (Bonferroni family coverage >= 95%) for the two primary dataset contrasts
inference.secondary_ci: paired 95% percentile intervals for all other estimates

decision_thresholds_pp.practical_change: wholly below -1 or above +1 resolves a practically meaningful change

inference.stopping_rule: no success-dependent stopping; complete the frozen main design even if the expected effect looks absent

exit_gate: every arm, seed, input hash, lambda rule, metric definition, and decision rule is recorded before main test results are opened
